title: Stephen Jones: We think we're close, still open to adding in a trade

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Stephen Jones: We think we're close, still open to adding in a trade
sources.description: Blowing a 14-point lead in the fourth quarter of an overtime loss to the Cardinals didn't do much to inspire confidence in the Cowboys from the general public, but it doesn't appear to have led to much of a change in the internal thinking about the team.
